subject: Update: Vendor banking & remittance address for Nimbus Supply Co.
messages:
From: Ava Torres <accounts@nimbus-supply.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: samir.desai@nimbus-supply.com
Date: 2025-10-08T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request to update bank details and remittance address

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the warm onboarding last month. We closed our onboarding checklist and have begun receiving POs — thank you. A quick change on our end: our bank was acquired and our ACH details are changing next week. Can you route the vendor record update through procurement so incoming payments after Oct 20 go to the new account?

Attached: Nimbus_BankChange_Form_20251008.pdf (bank change form, signature) and Updated_SOW_PO_45121.pdf (for reference to current PO).

New effective date: 2025-10-20.
Vendor ID (from your portal): 67843

Please let me know what approvals you need and if we should complete a DocuSign.

Best,
Ava Torres
Accounts Payable
Nimbus Supply Co.
(415) 555-0192
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Ava Torres <accounts@nimbus-supply.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-10-08T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to update bank details and remittance address

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the form. We can process a bank change but finance needs to validate the signed form and W-9 on file. Can you also confirm the remittance address change (if any) and whether the new account is under the same legal entity? If yes, this is usually a straight vendor-record update; if it's a separate entity we may require a new vendor setup.

Next steps from our side:
- Mina (procurement) will route this to finance for validation.
- Rishi (finance) will request running a micro-ACH verification if needed.
- If DocuSign is preferred, send me the link and I’ll route for signature.

I’ll follow up once I hear from finance.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2025-10-08T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus bank change — procurement intake

Forwarding vendor's request.

Quick notes:
- Vendor ID 67843; recently onboarded (onboarding checklist completed 2025-09-10).
- Attachments include a signed bank change form. I also see we only have an unsigned W-9 on file. Requesting that finance confirm (Rishi) before we update the vendor record.

Rishi — can you advise required controls (micro-deposit, verification call, DocuSign)? If safe, I can queue this for update effective 2025-10-20.

Mina
Procurement Manager
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2025-10-08T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus bank change — procurement intake

Thanks — flagged for validation. Checklist I need before we push the update:
1) Signed bank change form (received)
2) Current W-9 or equivalent tax doc (please provide signed copy)
3) Confirmation the legal entity name is unchanged
4) Signed authorization/attestation from vendor rep (DocuSign preferred)

Policy note: For vendors under $250k ARR we allow bank updates with a combination of signed form + micro-ACH. For vendors over that threshold we require an executive attestation. Nimbus is under the threshold but growing; we will do micro-ACH verification.

I’ll initiate the micro-ACH on Oct 16 so funds settle by Oct 20. If Ava can DocuSign the attestation we can fast-track.

-Rishi
Director, Finance Ops
From: Ava Torres <accounts@nimbus-supply.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: samir.desai@nimbus-supply.com
Date: 2025-10-09T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to update bank details and remittance address

Thanks Marissa and team —

Attached is a signed W-9 (W-9_NimbusSupply_signed.pdf). Legal entity remains the same. I created a DocuSign attestation and the link is here: https://www.docusign.com/verify/xyz-attachment. Samir will complete the DocuSign today. No remittance address change — only bank routing/account numbers change.

Let us know when you initiate micro-ACH.

Regards,
Ava
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Ava Torres <accounts@nimbus-supply.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2025-10-10T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Update: Bank change validated and vendor record updated (effective 2025-10-20)

Ava —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for completing the DocuSign attestation. We ran a micro-ACH verification (deposits initiated 2025-10-16) and confirmed the account. Your vendor record (ID 67843) has been updated in our AP system with the new ACH details and will go live for payments effective 2025-10-20. No changes were made to the remittance address.

Attached: copy of the verification log (stored in vendor profile) and final W-9.

If you need a copy of the vendor file sent to a different email, let me know. Otherwise we will process upcoming PO 45121 on the new account per standard payment terms.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
